about.en: LG Energy Solution Ltd. is a South Korean battery maker spun out of LG Chem, producing cylindrical and pouch cells on NCM and LFP chemistries for electric vehicles and energy storage, and offering energy services such as virtual power plants from six production regions worldwide. 373220 represents its common shares listed on the Korea Exchange, and derivative markets quote them under the LGENERGY ticker, sometimes rendered LG New Energy.
